sourceEntry: 2026-10-19 — Staff Rx submit and staff pricing access (local source)
releaseSummary: On the admin Rx form the button now reads "Send for submission". It sends the saved order to Rx Orders > Ready to release, where staff release it to the lab. It no longer adds the order to the staff member's cart.
Admin and operator profiles are approved for portal pricing against the Retail account, so store and pricelist prices show for staff. This was a data change on the live database only.

moduleImpact.notes: Updated as part of Staff Rx submit and staff pricing access (local source).

migrationNotes: No manual data migration is required for this release.
